close_reason: Shared message projections and authorized input/queue presentation validated.
description:
Source issue: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/834
Parent contract: zaq-zqq (read before implementation).

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
lib/zaq/engine/conversations.ex, conversations/message.ex, conversations/transcript_history.ex, conversations/execution_history.ex and engine/api.ex. Enrich list_messages/2 (retain Message structs), canonical projected_messages and authorized execution/admission/queue responses. Carry author, raw content, timestamp value/provenance separately. Persisted provider_sent_at wins; otherwise inserted_at means recorded time. Canonical SQL currently omits inserted_at/history_context from its projection: select only needed facts, never private metadata wholesale. Add domain-owned reads matching the legacy HistoryLoader queries, including completed-message filtering and ordering/limits, rather than forcing differently scoped reads through one incompatible query.
Tests to add before implementation: identical attribution/time for live persisted and restored message; provider versus recorded time; nil source time; multiple participants; Direct/Shared/Replicated history; legacy completed filtering; permission denial; finite batch queries; queue receipt projection.
Branches/paths validated: admission response excludes current message from prior history but still exposes its own presentation facts through the verified boundary; source cursors and dedup remain unchanged; no new global directory/message lookup surface. Non-persisted inputs use only trusted source time and otherwise no timestamp. Directory errors propagate through established error contracts.
Mocking plan: real authorized domain/database paths and NodeRouter dispatch; external transport only if necessary.
Documentations to update: Conversations/TranscriptHistory/ExecutionHistory/API contracts and docs/services/engine.md. Document author and timestamp provenance fields and backward compatibility.
Action reuse assessment: extend existing Conversations read and confidential execution operations, preserving actor/binding checks, limits, return compatibility and side effects. Do not create an attribution Action or resolve names inside agent tools. Legacy read consolidation is domain ownership, not permission broadening.
Acceptance: every supported message read has common attributed data without modifying persisted body or creating processing-time timestamps.

Completed: Message virtual author/timestamp fields and pure presentation_timestamp/1; batch MessageAuthor projection now includes provenance. list_messages and canonical transcript projections use shared policy. Canonical queries select only author-ref/agent-name metadata and remove internal selection fields afterward. Authorized admission includes sanitized input; queued receipt includes the persisted child presentation. Added domain list_agent_history preserving legacy completion/scope/500-row semantics for downstream loader migration. No new Engine API action needed: existing admission/queue handlers already forward responses. Added tests for provider/recorded timestamps, legacy scope/filtering, sanitized legacy/canonical admission and queued receipts. Validation: mix q passed; 7 properties, 128 tests, 0 failures across relevant domain suites.
title: [#834] Expose attributed message projections through Conversations boundaries
